title: Complete-intersection local algebra over a field
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $A$ a commutative $k$-algebra. It is a complete-intersection local algebra over $k$ if $A$ is local and essentially of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra], and there exist a regular local $k$-algebra $R$ [def-weil-regular-scheme] essentially of finite type over $k$ and a finite regular sequence $f_1,\ldots,f_c$ in the maximal ideal of $R$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence] with an isomorphism of $k$-algebras $R/(f_1,\ldots,f_c)\cong A$. The empty regular sequence is allowed.
